title: AI Daily 2026-11-11 · Entering the Field
description: Google opens Carbon and agent swarms, Anthropic prices its IPO and adds office tools, OpenAI introduces merchant agents, and DeepMind verifies Signal code.

google-gemini-4-carbon-general-availabil.topic: Google opens Gemini 4 Carbon to the public and previews /swarm agent teams
google-gemini-4-carbon-general-availabil.date_note: 2026-11-10 official post and same-day Verge reporting
google-gemini-4-carbon-general-availabil.verification_scope: Full Google DeepMind post across positioning, availability, pricing, swarm, benchmarks, cybersecurity, research and safety, and full Verge article reviewed. Carbon safety report, model card and benchmark leaderboards not opened. Google-reported figures, no independent replication.

anthropic-ipo-price-range.topic: Anthropic sets a $70–78 IPO range, implying a valuation up to about $1.4 trillion
anthropic-ipo-price-range.verification_scope: Both TechCrunch articles, The Verge and full Anthropic roadshow announcement reviewed. S-1/A not opened. Financials, subscriptions and governance follow TechCrunch. Reports differ on founder voting rights, 50.1% versus 51.1%, so text states only a majority. Listing date follows CNBC via TechCrunch.

anthropic-claude-meetings-sheets-whitebo.verification_scope: Full TechCrunch and Verge articles and opening of official Claude Whiteboards, Sheets and Data sections reviewed. Meetings documentation not separately opened. Details follow TechCrunch. No hands-on testing.

openai-chatgpt-business-agents.verification_scope: Full Verge and TechCrunch reports reviewed. OpenAI blog returned HTTP 403. Official statements follow their quotations. Verification methods undisclosed.
